description.html: Quartz gravel in a 1kg pack is a coarser-grained decorative material for aquariums. The larger gravel grains create an interesting texture on the aquarium floor and do not get sucked into the filter, which makes it a practical choice for aquariums with stronger filtration. It is chemically inert, does not affect water parameters and is safe for all freshwater aquariums.

The coarser grain lets food leftovers and waste collect on the surface between the grains, where the filter removes them more easily or they can be vacuumed during regular maintenance. Always rinse under running water before use. It can be combined with quartz sand to create interesting visual effects in aquascaping.
